Name: RelocateSaves
Author: AnotherPillow
Description:
A mod to move where Stardew Valley save files are.

[size=4]Installation[/size]

It goes in your mods folder.

[size=4]Configuration[/size]
You can use GMCM if you wish.

[list]
[*][code]NewSavePath[/code]- the new path to the saves folder. Default is
[code]null[/code]which means saves go to the default location.[/*]
[/list]
